mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.revision AS plan_revision, p.source_hash, report.status AS report_status, report.revision AS report_revision, report.issues_json::text AS issues_json FROM chapter_continuity_plans p JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = p.chapter_id AND ch.story_version_id = p.story_version_id JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = p.story_version_id AND sv.project_id = p.project_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cr.status, cr.revision, cr.issues_json FROM continuity_reports cr WHERE cr.plan_id = p.id ORDER BY cr.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) report ON TRUE WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND ch.current_storyboard_revision_id = p.storyboard_revision_id ORDER BY p.revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT state.visual_beat_id, state.scene_id, scene.order_index AS scene_order_index, beat.order_index AS beat_order_index, state.semantic_hash FROM visual_beat_continuity_states state JOIN scenes scene ON scene.id = state.scene_id AND scene.chapter_id = state.chapter_id JOIN visual_beats beat ON beat.id = state.visual_beat_id AND beat.scene_id = state.scene_id WHERE state.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY scene.order_index, beat.order_index, beat.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO regeneration_plans (id, project_id, chapter_id, continuity_plan_id, source_hash, requested_beat_ids_json, affected_beat_ids_json, reusable_beat_ids_json, reason, expires_at, input_fingerprint, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{continuityPlanId}, #{sourceHash}, #{requestedBeatIdsJson}::jsonb, #{affectedBeatIdsJson}::jsonb, #{reusableBeatIdsJson}::jsonb, #{reason}, #{expiresAt}, #{inputFingerprint}, #{createdBy}) ON CONFLICT (project_id, chapter_id, input_fingerprint) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT mp.image_aspect_ratio AS aspect_ratio, CASE WHEN mbp.prompt_template_version LIKE '%cinematic_anime' THEN 'CINEMATIC_ANIME' WHEN mbp.prompt_template_version LIKE '%storybook_watercolor' THEN 'STORYBOOK_WATERCOLOR' ELSE 'CINEMATIC' END AS image_style, mp.image_provider_key AS provider_key, mp.image_model_key AS model_key FROM media_plans mp LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT prompt_template_version FROM media_beat_plans WHERE media_plan_id = mp.id ORDER BY scene_index, beat_index LIMIT 1 ) mbp ON TRUE WHERE mp.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND mp.production_mode = 'IMAGE_MOTION' ORDER BY mp.revision DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_jobs SET regeneration_plan_id = #{regenerationPlanId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{generationJobId} AND job_type = 'CHAPTER_GENERATE' AND regeneration_plan_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT regeneration_plan_id FROM generation_jobs WHERE id = #{generationJobId} AND job_type = 'CHAPTER_GENERATE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO continuity_reports (plan_id, revision, status, issues_json, origin, reviewed_by, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{continuityPlanId}, #{revision}, #{status}, #{issuesJson}::jsonb, 'HUMAN', #{reviewedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
